review_scope: Complete Chinese–English alignment read with both full tables, title and deck. Complete existing English retained; thirteen local corrections pending independent second review. Authorisation/carrier layers, accepted objection, three friction classes, retained debts and primary-source verification limit all preserved.

changes.before: Layer two: the carrier. Machiavelli does not supply a third specimen of the same kind. He supplies a second-order stress test on layer one: even where the authoriser is itself constrained, the carrier that executes may form a war-interest of its own. Layer one asks whether the authoriser will move. Layer two asks whether, even with the authoriser still, the men who execute it will move on their own. Each layer has its own solution and its own insoluble part — and one layer's solution does not solve the other's problem.
changes.after: Layer two: the carrier. Machiavelli does not supply a third specimen of the same kind. He supplies a second-order stress test on layer one: even where the authoriser is itself constrained, the carrier that executes may form a war-interest of its own. Layer one asks whether the authoriser will move. Layer two asks whether, even with the authoriser still, the men who execute it will move on their own. Each layer has its own solutions and problems it cannot solve — and one layer's solution does not solve the other's problem.
changes.reason: 解不了 is relative to the layer's reach; do not turn it into an inherently insoluble problem.

The full treatment of layer two belongs to the question of how a means reworks the party using it, and that is not this volume's business.

changes.before: And On Protracted War, precisely because it writes the stopping condition in plain words, shows the problem most clearly. Its rule is: political purpose attained, war stops. That is the only stopping condition on this layer that can be quoted, questioned, and checked afterwards — in that sense it is the best of the two.

That is the only stopping condition among these two accounts on this layer that can be quoted, questioned, and checked afterwards — in that sense it is the best of the two.
changes.reason: Restore 本层两家里, limiting the comparison to the two authors discussed.

changes.before: And this is not two men's separate oversight. Two different authorisers give the same limit, which says the limit does not lie in the choice of authoriser but in the form of taking authorisation. It takes both side by side to see it: read Clausewitz alone and you will think his reason of state was insufficiently pure; read On Protracted War alone and you will think it a problem with one particular line. Two systems with unrelated sources landing at the same place says the place is structurally determined.

changes.reason: Correct subject–verb agreement without changing the inference.

changes.before: The objection: Clausewitz was not naive. He knew policy could be bad policy; he says in the same chapter that if the policy itself is wrong, no correctness of military means makes up for it. So he foresaw that the authoriser is unconstrained, and simply held that this belongs to politics and not to the theory of war.
changes.after: The objection: Clausewitz was not naive. He knew policy could be bad policy; he says in the same chapter that if the policy itself is wrong, no correctness of military means makes up for it. So he foresaw that the authoriser is unconstrained, and simply held that this belongs to political science and not to the study of war.
changes.reason: Restore the disciplinary distinction 政治学/战争学, rather than confuse the former with political activity.

changes.before: The objection holds, and this volume accepts it. To say ruling it out is exactly how the failure happens is a quibble: assigning a problem elsewhere is a legitimate declaration of range. This series makes heavy use of range declarations itself — silence on everything at the execution layer — so applying the same standard to a predecessor is the minimum.
changes.after: The objection holds, and this volume accepts it. To say putting it outside the scope is exactly how the failure happens is a quibble: assigning a problem elsewhere is a legitimate declaration of range. This series makes heavy use of range declarations itself — silence on everything at the execution layer — so applying the same standard to a predecessor is the minimum.
changes.reason: 划出去 means assigning the issue outside a theory's scope, not ruling out its possibility.

changes.before: A political purpose can demand that everything be sacrificed for it, including the very people it was meant to protect. A republic's survival can demand that citizens be turned into a supply of soldiers. A line can demand that individuals submit all the way down. Each of these demands is self-consistent in its own logic: an authoriser is entitled to dispose of what it authorises. Cultivation has no such entitlement, and the reason is categorial. Cultivation is not a goal. It is the very thing of a subject unfolding itself. A criterion that demands the abolition of that unfolding abolishes its own condition of holding. It is not that it violates cultivation. It cannot be said.
changes.after: A political purpose can demand that everything be sacrificed for it, including the very people it was meant to protect. A republic's survival can demand that citizens be turned into a supply of soldiers. A line can demand that individuals submit all the way down. Each of these demands is self-consistent in its own logic: an authoriser is entitled to dispose of what it authorises. Cultivation has no such entitlement, and the reason is categorial. Cultivation is not a goal. It is the very thing of a subject unfolding itself. A criterion that demands the abolition of that unfolding abolishes its own condition of holding. It is not that it violates cultivation. It is structurally impossible to say.
changes.reason: Restore the explicit structural qualification on unsayability.

changes.before: A particular good can mobilise. What it cannot do is acquire, on its own, the standing to begin a war, to widen one, or to be exempt from review. What the discipline blocks was never people fight for their homes. It is those four words being taken to replace the threshold. A reason to mobilise enters the first layer and does not enter the second; it does not impersonate authorisation.
changes.after: A particular good can mobilise. What it cannot do is acquire, on its own, the standing to begin a war, to widen one, or to be exempt from review. What the discipline blocks was never people fight for their homes. It is the phrase "for their homes" being taken to replace the threshold. A reason to mobilise enters the first layer and does not enter the second; it does not impersonate authorisation.
changes.reason: Restore the precise mobilising phrase and avoid a false translated word count.

changes.before: So the genuinely open question is a different one: how to let particular reasons for mobilising enter public action without impersonating the standing to authorise — a checkable division of labour between the language of mobilisation and the procedure of authorisation. That is a doable problem, not a dead end.
changes.after: So the genuinely open question is not "the criterion cannot mobilise," but this: how to let particular reasons for mobilising enter public action without impersonating the standing to authorise — a checkable division of labour between the language of mobilisation and the procedure of authorisation. That is a doable problem, not a dead end.
changes.reason: Restore the explicit rejected formulation, instead of leaving it only implicit.

changes.before: First, friction is not one thing. The sources he lists fall into at least three classes — physical conditions; conditions of information and stamina; and individuals each having their own direction. Only the third bears on the executor's position as a subject. An executor wholly inside the role still meets bad roads, wrong intelligence and fatigue. He does not stop producing friction. He stops producing the third class. Second, no longer produces is a universal claim, and there is no material for it. Whether a man in the role never again hesitates, never adjusts by his own understanding, never pauses when orders and what he sees conflict — that is an empirical question about people, and neither this volume nor Clausewitz offers evidence.
changes.after: First, friction is not one thing. The sources he lists fall into at least three classes — physical conditions; conditions of information and stamina; and individuals each having their own direction. Only the third bears on the executor's position as a subject. An executor wholly inside the role still meets bad roads, wrong intelligence and fatigue. He does not stop producing friction. He stops producing the third class. Second, no longer produces is a universal claim, and there is no material for it. Whether a man in the role never again hesitates, never adjusts by his own understanding, never pauses when orders and what he sees conflict — that is an empirical question about people. This volume makes no judgement on it, and Clausewitz supplies no evidence.
changes.reason: Preserve the two different admissions: the author withholds judgment; Clausewitz has not supplied evidence.

changes.before: What the inference does not claim has to be written down: it does not claim internalization guarantees correct judgement, and it does not claim internalized people will err in the same direction. What it claims is that some class of question can still be perceived, raised, and enter adjudication under pressure — and that is the only form in which a criterion still works outside its range.
changes.after: What the inference does not claim has to be written down: it does not claim internalization guarantees correct judgement, and it does not claim people who have internalized the criterion will err in the same direction. What it claims is that some class of question can still be perceived, raised, and enter adjudication under pressure — and that is the only form in which a criterion still works outside its range.
changes.reason: Repair the referent: people internalize a criterion; people are not themselves internalized.

changes.before: Internalization handles only cases the criterion already covers. Meet a new situation it does not cover and friction's wear applies in full, with the judge in the worst conditions. That family of problems has been settled by division rather than centrally: the moment the criterion is most needed is the moment judging conditions are worst is ruled out entirely — it belongs to executive judgement, outside this series' range, and is acknowledged rather than booked as unresolved. The criterion must be internalizable stays inside — it is a question about how criteria are written, and internalization there has an exact meaning: move the criterion from the subtracting end to the adding end in advance, because on a battlefield there is no time to subtract.
changes.after: Internalization handles only cases the criterion already covers. Meet a new situation it does not cover and friction's wear applies in full, with the judge in the worst conditions. That family of problems has been settled by division rather than centrally: the moment the criterion is most needed is the moment judging conditions are worst is placed wholly outside the scope — it belongs to executive judgement, outside this series' range, and is acknowledged rather than booked as unresolved. The criterion must be internalizable stays inside — it is a question about how criteria are written, and internalization there has an exact meaning: move the criterion from the condition-subtracting end to the condition-adding end in advance, because on a battlefield there is no time to subtract.
changes.reason: Restore the scope exclusion rather than impossibility, and specify that conditions are what the two methodological operations subtract/add.

changes.before: And the trinity leaves the people without standing to question — while SAE has given no replacement model. In wartime, where does questioning come from, who protects it, how is it kept from being treated as sapping morale? This volume does not answer, and the question bears directly on whether Theorem Four can be operated at all.
changes.after: And the trinity leaves the people without standing to question — while SAE has given no replacement model. In wartime, where does questioning come from, who protects it, how is it kept from being treated as sapping morale? changes.reason: Restore the operability question without the added absolute at all.

unresolved_source_questions.finding: Source says no unverified Total War-specific claims are used, but the preceding paragraph attributes specific positions to Ludendorff. A source-accounting question remains for the author; no primary-source verification was invented.

metadata_changes.before: Clausewitz and On Protracted War share one form of constraint: war is authorised by an external political purpose and constrained by it. And that form cannot restrain the authoriser itself.
metadata_changes.after: Clausewitz and On Protracted War share one form of constraint: war is authorised by an external political purpose and constrained by it. And that form cannot restrain the authoriser itself. The purpose may expand on its own in the course of the war.
metadata_changes.reason: Restore the specific mechanism by which the purpose escapes its own constraint.
